The molecular masses of the human proteins encoded by **ELL2** and **AHCYL2** according to UniProt are:

- **ELL2** (UniProt ID: [O00472](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O00472)):
  - Length: 640 amino acids
  - Molecular mass: 72,324 Da (~**72.32 kDa**)

- **AHCYL2** (UniProt ID: [Q96HN2](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q96HN2)):
  - Length: 764 amino acids
  - Molecular mass: 83,401 Da (~**83.40 kDa**)

Therefore, the protein encoded by **AHCYL2** is heavier than the protein encoded by **ELL2**.
